svg.text: Generic state machine in core. The definition belongs to the plugin that registered it.
States and permitted transitions — core validates, the plugin decides business rules
Each transition declares: source, target, required permission, validation hook, side-effect events.
Side effects run through an outbox — a rolled-back transition emits nothing.
Owner resource: rental order 4471 · pinned to definition v3 · row version 7
Invalid transition is rejected, not silently ignored
Stale row version loses — no lost update
Same idempotency key replays without a second effect
History stays readable after the plugin is deactivated
Definitions are immutable once used; v4 is a new row
Admin override exists only as an audited capability
